Third-party notices

Source: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

The DOST R package (R/, src/, man/, vignettes/) and the scripts written for this project are released under GPL-3 (see LICENSE.md).

The reproducibility/ directory also contains code written by others, used to run the baseline methods we compare against. That code keeps its original license and copyright. Each component is listed below.

Not redistributed

The following baseline methods are not part of this archive. Obtain them from their original repositories; the reproducibility READMEs describe how they are used.

Component Source License
GraphST https://github.com/JinmiaoChenLab/GraphST AGPL-3.0
ADEPT https://github.com/maiziezhoulab/ADEPT No license declared

reproducibility/ADEPT/ADEPT_compat.patch is our own small patch to ADEPT, to be applied to a clone of the original repository.

R baselines

BANKSY, BASS and DR.SC are installed from CRAN, Bioconductor or GitHub by the install.R scripts and are not redistributed here. The same applies to every package listed under Imports and Suggests in DESCRIPTION.

Data

No datasets are included. The datasets used in the paper are obtained from the sources listed in reproducibility/DOST/README.md, under their own terms.
